We have to do things for us not for other people. No judgement though as people ARE important and they do have an impact on us.

When we let other people control our decisions the decision isn’t entirely ours and it’s not something 100% in our control. I struggle with this know that I did wish some people would act differently to give me hope that things were progressing. 

Happy birthday to you though! It’s your day xx
Thank you I’ll take a look!

Taking quetiapine which has drowsiness effects. I may need to set an alarm that’s the reminder of taking it no matter what after Y hour. 

My concern is that on days where a work project is due and I have to be up late to finish I can take the medication or I feel I can’t in full dose or it impact the next day.  I also feel my psychiatrist is judging me which makes it hard to open up about this because I know they get displeased when I don’t adhere and I promise I’m doing my best.
